name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, serves static fixture pages, and applies host and web-server security settings.

name: cache
description: Configures Memcached and a single Redis instance on port 6379, including Redis logging, startup enablement, authentication, and a custom post-configuration workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs a FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub, provisions its Python environment and PostgreSQL database, and runs it through systemd on port 8000.
